ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from amino acid deamination during extended proteolysis; open cloth allows diffusion.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw pasture-milk p-cresol/indole plus cloth-rind Brevibacterium metabolites.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin and NSLAB proteolysis balanced by salt and age.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; no methyl-ketone blue-mold pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine plus fat browning on heating aged cheddar.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism in raw-milk cheddaring.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic acids from native lipase and NSLAB lipolysis over 14-24 months.

creaminess.reason: 37% fat gives mouth-coating despite firm aged matrix; no bloomy creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Aged cheddar calcium-phosphate solubilization and tyrosine crystals cause short fracture.

firmness.reason: Low ~33.5% moisture, calcium-crosslinked casein and 18-month maturation hard paste.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by NSLAB esterases.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in branched C8 goaty acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-methylbutanal/3-methylbutanal and roasted notes from long proteolysis.

melt.reason: Rennet-cheddar pH ~5.2 network flows with heat but reduced by long aging and proteolysis.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from cloth-rind fungi and linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Free-fat coalescence on melting from high 37% fat and aged oiling-off.

smoky.reason: No smoking; trace guaiacol/phenols only from pasture feed and rind.

sour_vinegar.reason: Low acetic acid from heterofermentative NSLAB buffered by aged low-moisture paste.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; cheddar milling/salting prevents fiber formation.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methional/DMDS from methionine catabolism; no high-heat cook.

sweet.reason: Sweet perception from glycerol, calcium lactate and delta-decalactone/dodecalactone.

umami.reason: High free glutamate and savory peptides from rennet, plasmin and NSLAB proteolysis.
